TABLE.NAME: flashdeck
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per flashdeck activity instance

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Deck name

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity introduction

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: scheduler
FIELD.COMMENT: Spaced-repetition scheduler for this deck: sm2 or leitner

FIELD.NAME: newperday
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum new cards introduced per learner per day

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum gradebook points from deck mastery; 0 = no grade

FIELD.NAME: completionstudied
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion rule: number of distinct cards to study; 0 = disabled

FIELD.NAME: completionmastery
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion rule: mastery percentage to reach; 0 = disabled

FIELD.NAME: modecram
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Cram study mode is available

FIELD.NAME: modetest
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Test study mode is available

FIELD.NAME: modematch
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Match game is available

TABLE.NAME: flashdeck_cards
TABLE.COMMENT: Cards belonging to a deck; type-specific payload lives in the content JSON

FIELD.NAME: deckid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning flashdeck instance

FIELD.NAME: cardtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Card type identifier from the card-type registry

FIELD.NAME: position
FIELD.COMMENT: Sort order within the deck

FIELD.NAME: tags
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated topic tags for filtering and reuse

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Validated JSON payload with the type-specific card content

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: User who last edited the card

INDEX.NAME: deckid-position
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast ordered listing of a deck

FIELD.NAME: deckid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning flashdeck instance, denormalised for fast due queries

FIELD.NAME: cardid
FIELD.COMMENT: Card being scheduled

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Learner this state belongs to

FIELD.NAME: easefactor
FIELD.COMMENT: SM-2 ease factor

FIELD.NAME: intervaldays
FIELD.COMMENT: Current interval in days

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp the card next becomes due

FIELD.NAME: repetitions
FIELD.COMMENT: Successful reviews in a row

FIELD.NAME: lapses
FIELD.COMMENT: Times the card fell back to relearning

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: new, learning, review or relearning

FIELD.NAME: lastgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Last self-grade: 0 again, 1 hard, 2 good, 3 easy

FIELD.NAME: lastreviewed
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last review

INDEX.NAME: cardid-userid
INDEX.COMMENT: One scheduling row per learner per card

INDEX.NAME: deckid-userid-duedate
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup of due cards in a deck

TABLE.NAME: flashdeck_session
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user per-day study aggregates powering streaks, points and analytics (privacy-sensitive)

FIELD.NAME: deckid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning flashdeck instance

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Learner this study day belongs to

FIELD.NAME: daystart
FIELD.COMMENT: Midnight (user timezone) of the study day

FIELD.NAME: reviews
FIELD.COMMENT: Cards reviewed this day

FIELD.NAME: correct
FIELD.COMMENT: Reviews graded Good or Easy this day

FIELD.NAME: points
FIELD.COMMENT: Points earned this day

FIELD.NAME: firstreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the first review this day

FIELD.NAME: lastreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last review this day

INDEX.NAME: deckid-userid-daystart
INDEX.COMMENT: One aggregate row per learner per deck per day
